regime: Silver under extra stress and gold in a short-term downtrend, with a tech-led selloff building in futures
takeaway: Gold slipped about 0.9% to near $4,030 and silver fell about 2.4%, pushing the gold/silver ratio above 76.5, the day after the Fed's hold with two officials wanting a hike. Nasdaq futures were down more than 1% after Alphabet's results, while yields eased a few basis points. Third-quarter growth came in at 3.4% with inflation as expected; how stocks and metals take that at the open can change this picture quickly.
